title: Who Is in Control Primer

edits.reason: Recovery leg tops at 110 (ltCandles 100 -> 79 -> 110) and markPoint idx15 'Δ Flips Teal — Squeeze Target' explicitly names the target, but the target PRICE is never drawn as a level. Intro illustrates the TA+SA confluence concept whose payoff is the squeeze target, so one gold TP line (gold = TP magnet per palette) closes the gap without over-annotating. yAxis 110 sits at the band top (79-110, +wick to ~112) so it renders cleanly.

This is the worked SETUP chart (START 95 -> 77 bars:8 -> 107 bars:8; band ~77-107, +wick to ~109) yet it draws ZERO markLines and ZERO markAreas. (1) The down-leg bottoms at 77 and markPoint idx9 'TA: DBS Bounce — SA Led This!' references the DBS level, but the level itself is invisible — the core TA level the whole lesson hangs on must be a teal line at 77, mirroring introChart. (2) markPoint idx15 'High Conviction Played Out' sits where the recovery tops at 107; draw that take-profit target as a gold line. (3) Wrap the DBS line in a teal confluence band 75-80 to match the intro (77-82) and quiz (72-78) charts, which both pair the DBS line with a confluence area. The 'SA leads' / 'extreme funding' callouts are SA sub-panel readings, not price levels, so they correctly need no markLine.

notes: Verified all coordinates against ltCandles legs. introChart Squeeze Target 110 = band top (valid). lessonChart DBS 77 = leg bottom, Target 107 = leg top, confluence 75-80 brackets the DBS line — all inside band. quiz.chart is intentionally left untouched: it has cutIndex:9 and the outcome (short squeeze + TA target at the ~106 recovery top) is correctly routed to revealMarkPoints idx14 'Short Squeeze + TA Target'.
